verdict.rationale: treg is a tool catalog and proxy, so security vetting of listed tools is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent quality signals: measured success rate, speed and price, usefulness reviews, credential health checks, and vendor listings submitted by pull request. Nothing documents scanning or inspecting listed tools or servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
